mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, admin_id AS adminId, title AS title, content AS content, is_active AS isActive, view_count AS viewCount, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM NOTICE WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY created_date DESC

SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, admin_id AS adminId, title AS title, content AS content, is_active AS isActive, view_count AS viewCount, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM NOTICE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}

SELECT n.notice_id AS notice_id, n.admin_id AS admin_id, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, n.is_active AS is_active, n.view_count AS view_count, n.created_date AS created_date, n.updated_date AS updated_date, i.image_id AS image_id, i.image_url AS image_url, i.sort_order AS sort_order, i.created_date AS image_created_date FROM NOTICE n LEFT JOIN NOTICE_IMAGE i ON n.notice_id = i.notice_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.image_id ASC
